title: 第13章 邪影
content_zh:
第13章 邪影
“我们走！”十字目光扫过雷队，身体果断倒退，一旁的鸾牙与蛮鬼同样这般，迅速退后。
许青眯起眼，望着雷队走向狼群的身影，看着其全身灵能爆发，对狼群形成的威慑。
他脚步没动，手中铁签微抬，寒芒于签尖闪过。
“小孩，你知道雷队为何是队长么。”远处飞跃离开的十字，传来遥遥的声音。
“并不仅仅因为雷队远超我等的凝气六层修为，更多是他身为队长在面对危机时的担当与判断。”
十字声音传来的同时，一声轰鸣于其所在之处回荡。
那是二百丈外的一棵大树，被十字以手中之弓抽断，轰然落地。
蛮鬼也是如此，鸾牙同样举动，一棵棵大树落下，形成遮拦的壁障，留一个空隙作为出口后，十字与鸾牙没有停顿，再次疾驰。
唯一手盾牌，一手狼牙棒的蛮鬼留在原地，靠在一棵大树旁，如一座小山，守在了那里。
与此同时，雷队那边也蓦然爆发，双手闪耀刺目之芒，冲入狼群。
所过之处狼群但凡与其碰触，必定血肉崩溃凄厉而亡。
只是狼群太多，很快雷队的身影就被淹没在内。
只有轰鸣与狼嚎，不断地传出，远处的十字，此刻也出来低吼。
“小孩，来与我们汇合，有你出手的时候！”
许青心底判断出这是雷霆小队的作战计划，于是不再迟疑直奔蛮鬼。
蛮鬼咧嘴一笑，指了指身后的缝隙出口，许青看了他一眼，从缝隙穿梭而过，向着远方的十字与鸾牙追去。
很快，他就看到清理出一片区域，以树木阻挡了四周，在那里忙碌的鸾牙。
她从身上取出诸多的粉末，铺散在周边，更是咬破手指，以鲜血于地面画下外人看不懂的图案。
察觉许青后，她没时间说话，眼神示意许青快走。

许青目光扫去，没有迟疑飞速掠过，直至在鸾牙后面二百丈外，他看到了蹲在一棵大树上的十字。
此树极高，仿佛是一个能对战场一览无余的制高点，蹲在那里的十字，望着疾驰靠近的许青，传出低沉的话语。
“我身后方向，二百丈外，你来负责！”
许青重重点头，对于雷霆小队的作战计划已了然于心。
一跃而去，到了二百丈的范围时，他立刻扫过四周，没去改变任何环境，而是藏身在一处灌木下的淤泥中。
与在废墟城池内狩猎一样，一动不动。
就在他藏身的一瞬，远方更强烈的轰鸣声隐隐传来。
树木遮挡，许青看不见八百丈之外的景象，但他能感受到那里战斗的激烈。
实际上的确如此，此刻，八百丈外雷队的身影从狼群内一冲而出，即便他是凝气六层，可在不能过多消耗下，也难免出现狼狈之意。
好在他对自身灵能控制很敏锐，保留了一半状态，在黑鳞狼的追击中，撤向蛮鬼。
蛮鬼狞笑，手中狼牙棒猛地抬起，在雷队从其身边跃过的一瞬，狠狠砸向追来的黑鳞狼。
制高位的十字，双眼也于这一刹凝神，手中强弓蓦然拉弦。
一支支灵能化作的箭矢带着尖锐的呼啸声，划出一道道风痕，落向狼群，辅助蛮鬼。
凄厉嘶吼再次回荡时，雷队已离开蛮鬼所在之地，向着鸾牙靠近，他的身后，蛮鬼独自一人，如山临大地，阻挡一切。
就这样，藏身在淤泥内的许青，看到的第一个归来者，就是于鸾牙与十字身边呼啸而过的雷队。
雷队从许青一旁飞驰，余光扫了眼他藏身之处，没时间开口只是点头，就立刻去了二百丈外，盘膝打坐吞下白丹，修整的同时，也为下一轮出手做准备。
这就是雷霆小队的撤退计划。
雷队身为最强者，最先阻拦，蛮鬼则是第二波拦截，快要力竭时他会撤离，阻拦狼群的任务将被鸾牙继续完成，然后是十字。
周而复始，如此一来，他们就可以各自有休息的时间。
这是最适合在异质浓郁禁区内的小队协同战斗方法。

而其中最累的，就是雷队与十字。
前者阻拦时间最久，杀狼最多，为身后队友争取大量的时间。
至于后者，除了自身要作为拦截狼群的一环外，还要在制高点上为队友撤退时的安全作保障。
可以说每一个人的安排，都很重要，而最重要的就是他们彼此的默契与信任！
“这就是拾荒者小队么……”
许青目露坚定，藏身不动，随着时间流逝，很快他看到蛮鬼气喘临近的身躯。
又在片刻后，望见了鸾牙捂着胸口，面色苍白的身影。
最后一个从他身边驰过的，是十字。
他面色冷峻，看似如常，可许青还是感受到他身上灵能近乎枯竭的波动，他的身后，狼群密密麻麻嘶吼追击。
路过许青这里时，十字仿佛有些迟疑。
“我可以。”许青看出对方未语之意，沉声开口。
十字没说话，一晃离开，瞬息间，狼群呼啸而来。
掀起的风吹过许青的面孔，带着腥臭之味，尤其是最前方的十多头，全身漆黑眼睛赤红，浑身上下散发出凶残与疯狂。
显然雷霆小队第一轮的作战安排，使它们受到了不小的死伤，血腥的刺激下，让这些黑鳞狼变的狂暴无比。
此刻它们似乎没有注意到藏身的许青，正要追击十字。
可就在它们到来的刹那，一把匕首蓦然飞出，呼的一声临近，直接刺入最前方那头黑鳞狼的额头。
力度之大，瞬息贯穿。
这黑鳞狼发出凄厉之音，骤然毙命，尸体带着惯性落地的同时，许青身影化作残痕，奔雷而出。
手中黑色铁签闪耀寒芒，猛地刺入一头黑鳞狼的眼睛里，贯穿头部后他身体一晃左手握拳，用力轰向身后扑来欲偷袭的第三头狼。
狼头骤然碎裂，鲜血溅了许青一身。

刹那击毙三狼，许青身影再次晃动。
他的速度于这一刻完美显露。
整个人无比灵活，如杀戮的罗刹，在狼群内游走穿梭，目光冰冷，出手果断。
随着黑色铁签的锋芒，一头头黑鳞狼死亡前的惨叫，传遍四方。
他身上的狼血越来越多，双手更是被染的鲜红，虽黏糊糊，可抓着的铁签依旧牢固，铁签的颜色，此刻也变成了赤色。
只不过狼群分布，终究有一些从他身边飞跃而过。
还有一些爪牙，在他身上留下了伤口。
可在许青的速度下，前者被他勉强冲出阻拦，而后者……他紫色水晶恐怖的恢复力，在这一战，发挥了奇效。
一切皮外伤都在几个呼吸中快速愈合，即便是较重的伤势，也不再流血。
这一幕，因他全身被狼血弥漫，所以外人看不清晰。
而相比伤势的痊愈，他体力的恢复才更为恐怖，整个人的持续战力，得到了惊人的延续。
于是渐渐的，他四周狼尸遍地，眼睛里凌厉越来越寒，坚持的时间超越了所有人，使得四周的狼群，竟也都出现了一些被其震慑之意。
远远看去，阳光穿透浓密的树叶，零散落在他的身上，折射出的光在其全身鲜血弥漫中，仿佛将他化作了一道血芒。
而这一幕，也被他身后二百丈外的雷队与更远处制高点的十字看到。
二人都心神掀起波动，显然被许青的狠辣与坚韧所震动。
“小孩，撤退！”雷队蓦然开口。
许青还有余力，可他也感受到了灵能的严重损耗。
紫色水晶虽可以恢复体力与伤势，但灵能的损耗无法弥补。
好在他是炼体，不像鸾牙，没了灵能就无法出手。
但终究还是有些影响，使他不得不去吸收四方混合浓郁异质的灵能，手臂异化点的刺痛越发强烈。

所以在听到雷队的话语后，许青没有迟疑，立刻后退。
可就在他后退的一瞬，狼群里一头眼睛并非全红，而是单眼黑色的黑鳞狼，一跃而起，扑向许青。
许青目中寒芒闪耀，手中铁签化作血痕，蓦然间将其头颅穿透，身体刚要继续后退，但就在这时……
斑驳的阳光下，他不知是不是错觉，这具坠落的黑鳞狼尸体，其影子仿佛扭曲起来。
竟在地面向着许青这里飞速蔓延。
而此地的阳光只是零散，并非浓郁，所以这一切让他无法第一时间确定，下一瞬，那影子就与他的身体碰到了一起。
许青身体猛地一震。
一股难以形容的邪恶之意，刹那就要侵袭全身。
可就在这顷刻间，那被埋入胸口，除恢复力外从始至终没有任何异动的紫色水晶。
竟在这一刻蓦然震动，一股寒流从内爆发出来。
随着爆发，那种被邪恶侵袭的感觉刹那消失。
而这寒流来的快，消失的也一样快，转眼间就无影无踪，紫色水晶也恢复正常，如以往一样一动不动。
许青一愣，但此刻来不及多想，身体恢复后他疾驰倒退，而方才的一幕，也都是瞬间发生，所以无论是雷队还是远处的十字，都不曾发现丝毫。
此刻在许青退后中，雷队迈步迎来，目中残留震动之意。
“你做的很好，快去后方休息。”
“生活在禁区深处的黑鳞狼，喜异质浓郁之地，而外围区域相对深处异质淡了不少，所以不管它们因何出现，它们不喜欢这里，只要久攻不下，必会自行离去。”
说完，雷队全身灵能爆发迈着大步，向着许青身后追来的黑鳞狼冲击过去。
蛮鬼的身影也飞速到来，显然是他在后面等了许久，心底也因时间的太长而焦虑，此刻到来看见许青全身的鲜血以及不远处那无数的狼尸后，他也吸了口气，上前就要去扶住许青。
“无妨。”许青没让对方搀扶，回头看了眼雷队，最终在蛮鬼敬佩的目光下，快步远去。
路过鸾牙时，她似乎也得到了消息，看到许青后神色带着震撼，想了想，从身上取出一个皮袋扔给了他。

许青接过，摸到里面丹药的形状，心底已知晓是何物，于是向鸾牙道谢，在鸾牙的目光里，飞速远去，直至看到了十字。
十字于树冠上默不作声，向着许青点头，目中的认同很是明显。
许青也没说话，轻轻点头示意，到了最后方时，他才找了个位置坐下，吐出一口浊气，拿出白丹吞下三枚。
随着丹药的融化，他开始吸收四周的灵能恢复。
时间流逝，半个时辰后，许青睁开了眼，精神的疲惫得到了缓冲，可目中却露出一抹迷惑，他发现自己体内的异质，似乎……并不是很多。
于是撸起左手的袖子看去，眼睛里的迷惑，刹那变成了惊疑。
他手臂上的异化点，居然……少了一个！
可修为明明还是炼体二层，且经历了之前的厮杀后，非但没有减弱，反倒是随着此刻的恢复，似比之前还要精进。
尤其他记得很清晰，之前厮杀时因被动吸收灵能，手臂两个异化点都有强烈的刺痛。
至于白丹，许青之前不是没吃过，效果不会如此惊人，但此时似乎也没有什么其他的解释。
除了……紫色水晶寒流瞬间爆发之事。
“影子、邪恶之意、水晶爆发寒流……”
许青眯起眼，回忆之前那诡异的一幕。
他确定自己所看影子碰触自己之事，绝不是眼花，也更不是阳光散落的错觉。
于是他仔细回想水晶爆发寒流的一幕，似乎在那一瞬，侵袭自己的邪恶之意，被寒流卷走，吸入到了水晶内。
“吃了？”许青有些惊疑的猜测。
好久没登陆，觉得起点很陌生，都不会操作了，看见你们说角色卡，说卷名的事，于是捣鼓了好久，才弄明白……添加了卷名。
第一卷，惊蛰。
惊蛰反映的是自然生物受节律变化影响，出现萌发生长的现象。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 13 Evil Shadow
"Let's go!" His cross-eyed gaze swept over the Lei team, and his body stepped back decisively. Luan Ya and Barbarian Ghost on the side did the same, quickly retreating.
Xu Qing squinted his eyes, watching Lei Dui's figure walking towards the wolves, and watching the burst of psychic energy from his whole body, which was a deterrent to the wolves.
He didn't move, he raised the iron stick in his hand slightly, and a cold light flashed on the tip of the stick.
"Kid, do you know why Captain Lei is the captain?" A distant voice came from the cross leaping away in the distance.
"It's not just because Captain Lei's sixth-level cultivation of Qi Condensation is far superior to mine, but more importantly because of his responsibility and judgment when facing a crisis as a captain."
At the same time as the sound of the cross came, a roar echoed where it was.
It was a big tree 200 feet away, which was cut off by Cross with the bow in his hand, and fell to the ground with a crash.
The same was true for the barbarian ghost, and Luan Ya acted the same way. Big trees fell down one after another, forming a blocking barrier. After leaving a gap as an exit, Cross and Luan Ya did not pause and started galloping again.
The barbarian ghost with only a shield in one hand and a mace in the other stayed where he was, leaning against a big tree, like a hill, guarding there.
At the same time, the Thunder Team suddenly erupted, their hands shining with dazzling light, and they rushed into the wolves.
If the wolves come into contact with them wherever they pass, their flesh and blood will collapse and they will die tragically.
There were just too many wolves, and Team Lei’s figure was quickly submerged.
Only roars and howls of wolves continued to be heard, and the cross in the distance also roared at this moment.
"Child, come and join us, you will take action when you can!"
Xu Qing judged in his heart that this was the Thunder Team's battle plan, so he went straight to the Barbarians without hesitation.
The barbarian ghost grinned and pointed at the exit of the gap behind him. Xu Qing glanced at him, passed through the gap, and chased the cross and Luan Fang in the distance.
Soon, he saw an area cleared, blocked off by trees, and Luan Ya was busy there.
She took out a lot of powder from her body and spread it around. She even bit her fingers and drew patterns on the ground with blood that were incomprehensible to outsiders.
After noticing Xu Qing, she had no time to speak and her eyes signaled Xu Qing to leave quickly.
Xu Qing's eyes swept across the area without hesitation until he saw the cross squatting on a big tree two hundred feet away behind Luan Ya.
The tree was extremely tall, as if it was a commanding height with an unobstructed view of the battlefield. Cross squatting there looked at Xu Qing who was approaching at a rapid speed, and spoke in a low voice.
"The direction behind me, two hundred feet away, is your responsibility!"
Xu Qing nodded heavily, already knowing the Thunder Team's battle plan.
He jumped away, and when he reached a range of two hundred feet, he immediately scanned the surroundings without changing any environment. Instead, he hid in the mud under a bush.
It's like hunting in a ruined city, motionless.
The moment he hid, a stronger roar came faintly from the distance.
The trees blocked Xu Qing's view of the scene eight hundred feet away, but he could feel the intensity of the battle there.
In fact, this is indeed the case. At this moment, the figure of Lei Team 800 feet away rushed out from the wolf pack. Even if he was at the sixth level of Qi Condensation, he would inevitably look embarrassed as long as he could not consume too much.
Fortunately, he was very sensitive to his own psychic control, so he retained half of his state, and retreated towards the wild ghosts while being pursued by the black-scaled wolf.
The barbarian ghost smiled ferociously, raised the mace in his hand suddenly, and hit the pursuing black-scaled wolf hard the moment Lei Dui jumped over him.
The cross in the high position also focused its eyes at this moment, and the strong bow in its hand suddenly pulled the string.
Arrows transformed from spiritual energy made a sharp whistling sound, leaving wind marks, and fell towards the wolves, assisting the wild ghosts.
When the shrill roar echoed again, Lei Dui had left the place where the barbarian ghosts were and was approaching Luan Ya. Behind him, the barbarian ghosts were alone, like a mountain on the earth, blocking everything.
In this way, Xu Qing, who was hiding in the mud, saw the first returner, who was whizzing past Luanya and Shizi.Team Thunder.
Lei Dui flew past Xu Qing and glanced at his hiding place with his peripheral vision. He didn't have time to speak and just nodded. He immediately went two hundred feet away, sat cross-legged and meditated and swallowed the white pill. While repairing, he also prepared for the next round of attacks.
This is the Thunder Team's retreat plan.
As the strongest one, Team Lei will be the first to intercept, while Barbarian Ghost will be the second interceptor. When he is almost exhausted, he will retreat. The task of blocking the wolves will be completed by Luan Ya, and then Cross.
The cycle starts over and over again, so that they can each have their own time to rest.
This is the most suitable team cooperative combat method in a heterogeneous and dense restricted area.
The most tiring of them all is Lei Dui and Cross.
The former blocks the longest, kills the most wolves, and buys a lot of time for the teammates behind them.
As for the latter, in addition to being a part of intercepting the wolves, they also have to ensure the safety of their teammates when they retreat from the commanding heights.
It can be said that everyone's arrangements are very important, and the most important thing is their mutual understanding and trust!
"Is this the scavenger team..."
Xu Qing's eyes were firm and he remained motionless. As time passed, he soon saw the panting body of the barbarian ghost approaching.
After a while, he saw Luan Ya covering his chest with a pale face.
The last one passing by him was Cross.
His expression was stern, seemingly as usual, but Xu Qing could still feel the fluctuations of nearly exhausted spiritual energy in his body. Behind him, wolves were densely roaring and pursuing him.
When passing by Xu Qing, Cross seemed a little hesitant.
"I can." Xu Qing saw what the other party meant and said in a deep voice.
Cross didn't say anything, and left in a flash. In an instant, the wolves roared towards him.
The rising wind blew over Xu Qing's face, bringing with it a fishy smell, especially the dozen or so heads at the front, whose bodies were dark and their eyes were red, and they exuded ferocity and madness.
Obviously, the Thunder Team's first round of combat arrangements caused them to suffer a lot of casualties. The bloody stimulation made these black-scaled wolves become extremely violent.
At this moment, they seemed not to notice Xu Qing who was hiding and was about to pursue Cross.
But at the moment they arrived, a dagger suddenly flew out, approaching with a roar, and pierced directly into the forehead of the black-scaled wolf at the front.
The force is so strong that it penetrates instantly.
The black-scaled wolf made a shrill sound and died suddenly. When the body fell to the ground with inertia, Xu Qing's figure turned into scars and thundered out.
The black iron stick in his hand shone with cold light and pierced into the eyes of a black-scaled wolf. After piercing the head, he shook his body and made a fist with his left hand, slamming hard at the third wolf that was rushing behind him to attack.
The wolf's head suddenly shattered and blood splashed all over Xu Qing.
The three wolves were killed in an instant, and Xu Qing's figure shook again.
His speed was perfectly revealed at this moment.
The whole person is extremely flexible, like a killing Rakshasa, wandering among the wolves, with cold eyes and decisive strikes.
Following the sharp edge of the black iron stick, the screams of black-scaled wolves before they died spread throughout the world.
There was more and more wolf blood on his body, and his hands were dyed bright red. Although they were sticky, the iron stick he was holding was still firm, and the color of the iron stick also turned red at this moment.
It's just that the distribution of wolves meant that some of them leaped past him after all.
There were also some minions that left wounds on his body.
But with Xu Qing's speed, the former was barely blocked by him, and the latter... The terrifying resilience of his purple crystal worked wonders in this battle.
All skin injuries heal quickly within a few breaths, and even the more serious injuries no longer bleed.
This scene, because his whole body was filled with wolf blood, so outsiders could not see clearly.
Compared with the recovery of his injuries, the recovery of his physical strength was even more terrifying, and his sustained combat power was astonishingly extended.
So gradually, wolf corpses were everywhere around him, and his eyes became sharper and colder. He persisted longer than anyone else, and all the wolves around him actually appeared.Some were shocked by it.
Looking from a distance, the sunlight penetrated the dense leaves and scattered on his body. The refracted light seemed to turn him into a bloody glow amid the blood all over his body.
